name: iclr2026
description: ICLR 2026 open-weight review panel. Uses the real ICLR 2026 form (even-only 0-10 overall rating; soundness/presentation/contribution 1-4; confidence 1-5) via prompts/iclr-form.md (rubric'd) and prompts/iclr-naive.md (reviewer who pasted the PDF into a chatbot). target = free-tier-chatbot threat model; tough = the reasoning canary that must not drop while targets rise; holdout is never consulted during revision, run it only at baseline and final. Calibrate the model set against an accepted sibling paper before trusting absolute scores; open models drift between overgenerous and too harsh across releases.
